messages.message:
Patch Set 1:

(6 comments)

AI code review results below, please doublecheck

Some concerns, see inline comments. The same pending-SIGINT hazard looks unaddressed on the OST side: lfsck_layout_slave_double_scan() leaves its while (!lfsck_should_stop()) loop into the done: label and calls lfsck_layout_slave_notify_master() (lustre/lfsck/lfsck_layout.c:6516) from the master-engine kthread that lfsck_stop() has just signalled at lfsck_lib.c:3392, and those notify RPCs set rq_allow_intr as well. Is that deliberately out of scope, or should the flush go there too? A sanity-lfsck case that stops LFSCK mid-scan and then checks the peers really stopped would also help pin this down.

Uploaded patch set 2.
